Name: Prismatic Tools by Matt
Author: mdurham6890
Description:
[size=5][b]Prismatic Tool Upgrades[/b][/size]
[i]The ultimate tier beyond Iridium.[/i]
[size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size]
Prismatic Tool Upgrades adds a new [b]Prismatic[/b] upgrade tier to every tool in Stardew Valley. Each tool gains powerful new abilities that make late-game farming, mining, and foraging more rewarding. Upgrades are obtained through Clint's blacksmith shop using [b]Prismatic Slabs[/b] — a new crafting material smelted from Prismatic Shards.
[line]
[size=4][b]Prismatic Slabs[/b][/size]
The crafting material used for all Prismatic upgrades.
[list]
[*][b]Furnace[/b]: 5 Prismatic Shards + 1 Coal = 1 Prismatic Slab
[*][b]Heavy Furnace[/b]: 25 Prismatic Shards + 3 Coal = 5 Prismatic Slabs
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]Tools & Abilities[/b][/size]
[size=3][b]Prismatic Axe[/b][/size]
[i]Upgrade Cost: 50,000g + 5 Prismatic Slabs (requires Iridium Axe)[/i]
[list]
[*]Chops through any tree, stump, hollow log, or giant crop in a single swing
[*]+1 Speed and +1 Magnetism while held
[/list]
[size=3][b]Prismatic Pickaxe[/b][/size]
[i]Upgrade Cost: 50,000g + 5 Prismatic Slabs (requires Iridium Pickaxe)[/i]
[list]
[*]5x5 area-of-effect mining — shatters all rocks in a 2-tile radius around the impact
[*]One-shots all ore nodes up to Iridium (Radioactive ore is intentionally skipped in the AOE)
[*]Breaks boulders, meteorites, and artifact spots in the AOE
[*]+1 Speed and +1 Magnetism while held
[/list]
[size=3][b]Prismatic Omniaxe[/b][/size]
[i]Forge Cost: 50 Cinder Shards (combine Prismatic Pickaxe + Prismatic Axe at the Volcano Forge)[/i]
[list]
[*]Combines all abilities of the Prismatic Pickaxe and Prismatic Axe into one tool
[*]5x5 AOE mining + instant tree chop + breaks wood debris and stumps in the AOE
[*]+2 Speed and +2 Magnetism while held (enhanced)
[*]Enchantments from both source tools are transferred
[*]Can be separated back into Pickaxe + Axe at the Forge (Omniaxe + Radioactive Bar, 50 Cinder Shards)
[*]Enchantments are split between tools on separation (Pickaxe gets priority)
[/list]
[size=3][b]Prismatic Fishing Rod[/b][/size]
[i]Upgrade Cost: 50,000g + 5 Prismatic Slabs (requires Advanced Iridium Rod, purchased at Clint's)[/i]
[list]
[*]Built-in fish radar — always shows fish identity during the minigame (like a permanent Sonar Bobber)
[*]Built-in Magic Bait effect — catch any fish regardless of season, time, or weather (toggleable, see below)
[*]Enhanced catch bar (+24px larger)
[*]3 attachment slots (1 bait + 2 tackle)
[*]Bonus treasure drops: Iridium Ore, Diamond, Prismatic Shard, and Treasure Chest
[/list]
[size=3][b]Prismatic Hoe[/b][/size]
[i]Upgrade Cost: 25,000g + 1 Prismatic Slab (requires Iridium Hoe)[/i]
[list]
[*]6x6 tilling area at full charge (beyond Iridium's 5x5)
[*]Summon sunshine for tomorrow using the keybind (default: LeftShift + Right Click)
[/list]
[size=3][b]Prismatic Watering Can[/b][/size]
[i]Upgrade Cost: 25,000g + 1 Prismatic Slab (requires Iridium Watering Can)[/i]
[list]
[*]Summon rain for tomorrow using the keybind (default: LeftShift + Right Click)
[/list]
[size=3][b]Prismatic Pan[/b][/size]
[i]Upgrade Cost: 25,000g + 1 Prismatic Slab (requires Iridium Pan)[/i]
[list]
[*]6-tile collection radius (expanded from Iridium's 4 tiles)
[*]Stacks with the Reaching enchantment for even more range
[*]Enhanced rare drops: Iridium Ore, Gold Ore, gems, Diamond, and a chance for Prismatic Shard
[/list]
[size=3][b]Prismatic Scythe[/b][/size]
[i]Purchase Cost: 25,000g + 2 Prismatic Slabs (requires Iridium Scythe, purchased at Clint's)[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Charged swing system[/b]: Quick tap for a 6x6 AOE, hold ~0.33 seconds for a massive 15x15 AOE
[*]Green tile overlay shows the target area while charging
[*]Move freely while charging — the AOE follows you
[*]Harvests ALL crop types (both scythe-harvest and hand-pick crops like berries and cauliflower)
[*]Instant grass cutting — clears all grass in one swing regardless of density
[*]Shakes fruit trees in the AOE, dropping their fruit
[*]Auto-collects forage items from the ground (respects Botanist profession for iridium quality)
[*]Clears weeds and debris, deals damage to monsters in the full area
[*]+4 Magnetism while held (raises effective pickup radius from 2 to 6 tiles)
[/list]
[size=3][b]Prismatic Trash Can[/b][/size]
[i]Purchase Cost: 25,000g + 1 Prismatic Slab (requires Iridium Trash Can, purchased at Clint's)[/i]
[list]
[*]Returns 100% gold value on all trashed items (Iridium is only 60%)
[*]Works on weapons, rings, and boots
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]Keybind Abilities[/b][/size]
Several Prismatic tools have special abilities activated with the keybind (default: [b]LeftShift + Right Click[/b] on keyboard, [b]A + X[/b] on controller).
[list]
[*][b]Watering Can[/b]: Summon rain for tomorrow
[*][b]Hoe[/b]: Summon sunshine for tomorrow
[*][b]Fishing Rod[/b]: Toggle the built-in Magic Bait effect on/off via a dialogue prompt
[*]Configurable in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] or via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Edit [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] inside the [font=Courier New]PrismaticToolCompanion[/font] folder, or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change settings in-game.
[list]
[*][b]WeatherKeybind[/b] — Keybind for weather summoning and Magic Bait toggle (default: LeftShift + Right Click / A + X)
[*][b]PrismaticRodMagicBait[/b] — Enable or disable the built-in Magic Bait effect on the Prismatic Rod (default: true)
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*]Download and extract [b]both[/b] folders into your [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] directory:
[list]
[*][font=Courier New][CP] PrismaticToolUpgrades[/font] — Content Patcher pack (tool data, textures, shop entries)
[*][font=Courier New]PrismaticToolCompanion[/font] — C# mod (gameplay mechanics)
[/list]
[*][b]Optional[/b]: Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20357]Item Extensions[/url] for enhanced Pan and Fishing Rod drop tables
[*][b]Optional[/b]: Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game settings
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0+
[*]Content Patcher 2.0+
[*]Works with or without Item Extensions (graceful fallback for Pan drops)
[*]Works with or without Generic Mod Config Menu
[/list]

[code]
Tool                  | Prerequisite          | Gold    | Slabs | Location
──────────────────────┼───────────────────────┼─────────┼───────┼──────────

Prismatic Scythe      | Iridium Scythe        | 25,000g |   2   | Clint
Prismatic Trash Can   | Iridium Trash Can     | 25,000g |   1   | Clint

Downloads.Description: Fixed an issue with twigs not being cut by the omniaxe. Also made some changes to the fishing rod and scythe. Refer to the description to see all the new/altered features. I forgot to include the second folder. It's included in 3.2.1

Manifest.Name: Prismatic Tool Companion
Manifest.Description: Companion mod for Prismatic Tool Upgrades. Adds gameplay mechanics: instant chop, AOE mining, fish radar, 100% trash return, enhanced panning, 6x6 hoe/scythe, weather summoning, and scythe magnetism.
Manifest.Author: mdurham6890
